thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: sudden uplift in 5xx at edge proxy starting 00:12 UTC — 17% error rate across eu-west frontends. Paging mike-oncall.

mike-oncall: looking at it now. any customer-facing alerts?

incident-bot: spikes correlated with deploys to apigw-edge cluster at 00:10 UTC (config v12). Some 502/504, some TCP resets.

mike-oncall: noted. rolling diagnostics: `curl -I https://edge-eu.redwood.internal/health` shows intermittent 502s. tailing proxy logs now.

kyle-sre: I'm joining — pulling traces and kvcache metrics. rough thought: upstream pools showing connection refusals.

anne: support FYI — we already have 3 tickets reporting timeouts from EU mobile users. Marking as high.

mike-oncall: quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle long requests, 2) circuit-break to upstream group A, 3) revert recent config if needed. starting with traffic reroute to standby region.

mike-oncall: command: `kubectl -n infra patch svc/apigw-edge --patch '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Cluster"}}'` — testing conservative change to affinity.

deployer-bot: Rolling rollback: config apigw-edge v12 -> v11 initiated by mike-oncall at 00:20 UTC.

kyle-sre: I pushed a temporary routing rule to steer 30% of eu-west traffic to eu-north standby via smart-router. watch metrics for increased latency.

mike-oncall: CPU on edge-proxy pods normal, but upstream connection error count spiked ~00:11-00:14. stack traces show `connect: connection reset by peer` to model-cache service.

raj: any correlation with autoscaler events? might be connection pool exhaustion after burst.

kyle-sre: autoscaler didn't trigger. pool sizes look unchanged. I suspect an external load balancer health-checking aggressively after the config push.

lucy-pm: customer-impact summary for comms team: ~30% of mobile app requests from EU had 5xx; web clients saw ~8% errors. No paid-customer SLA breaks reported yet.

mike-oncall: rolling back config completed at 00:26 UTC per deployer-bot. initial error rate down to 6% and trending.

kyle-sre: added short-term circuit-break thresholds and reduced max concurrent upstream conns from 300 -> 180. Applying: `envoy config replace --service apigw-edge --config-file /tmp/patch.yaml`

anne: support notified customers on impacted tickets; recommended temporary workaround: retry w/ exponential backoff.

mike-oncall: monitoring: 5xx now stabilized at 3-5% and falling. keeping command-room open for next 45m. handoff to kyle-sre in 20m for overnight watch.

kyle-sre: acknowledged. I'll keep an eye and prepare for diag run if rate creeps above 8%.

lucy-pm: please flag any customers that escalate — we'll pre-draft messaging.

mike-oncall: summary for post-incident: probable root cause = config v12 change triggering aggressive LB health checks + upstream pool sensitivity leading to transient connection resets. action items: (1) add canary window to config rollouts, (2) add pool resize guardrail, (3) update runbook for circuit-break thresholds.

kyle-sre: I'll own the runbook edits and an automated pre-rollout traffic-shift check.

mike-oncall: closing pager for now. tagging incident as `mitigated` — will open a full postmortem if tickets or metrics show reoccurrence. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident -> mitigated (00:34 UTC). If new alerts appear, pager will re-open.
